messages:
Priya Nair: Quick idea for the role editor UI — show an "impact heatmap" when you select a role to grant. highlights routes that will become reachable + a simple risk tag (low/med/high) for quota exposure.
Sam Cortez: ooh. concrete metrics for "risk"?
Priya Nair: not per-token this time. basic outputs: number_of_endpoints_exposed, percent_of_traffic_exposed, and a quota_saturation_risk computed from historical rate vs tenant quota. keep it lightweight.
Evan Li: Implementation sketch: we already have route access logs and per-route usage metrics. run a dry-run that maps role -> candidate routes (based on current policies) and join with 7-day traffic histograms to compute exposure.
Evan Li: Draft internal contract:```POST /internal/rbac/dryrun
{ "tenant_id": "t-123", "role_id": "role-readonly", "lookback_days": 7 }
Response:
{ "summary": "{\"endpoints_exposed\":12,\"traffic_pct\":15}", "routes": [ "{\"path\":\"/v1/embeddings\",\"traffic_pct\":4,\"risk\":\"low\"}", "{\"path\":\"/v1/generate\",\"traffic_pct\":9,\"risk\":\"high\"}" ], "assumptions": "aggregated logs, no raw payloads, sample_version=v1" }```
Taylor G.: must be opt-in at org level (privacy). default off for tenants that haven't enabled aggregated rbac sampling. show CTA in console: "Enable impact previews (admin only)".
Sam Cortez: storage/perf note: do NOT compute on-demand for every UI click. instead precompute role->route mappings nightly and cache per-tenant exposures; UI hits read-only endpoint.
Evan Li: Agree. Also include a confidence score based on sample size and traffic volatility. show a tiny meter in the modal.
Priya Nair: UX: inline tiny badge next to grant button: "Preview impact" -> opens modal with heatmap overlay over routes + list sorted by risk + per-route sparkline (7d). also allow download CSV for audits.
infra-bot: daily job scheduled: rbac-dryrun-indexer v1 deployed, will populate /internal/rbac/dryrun cache after first run :rocket:
Taylor G.: Security: return only aggregated metrics (no user IDs or raw headers). enterprise tenants can opt into more detailed breakdowns but default must be coarse.
Sam Cortez: API contract detail: response fields should be flat and small (strings/numbers) so console SDK parsing stays simple. include sample_version and index_ts.
Evan Li: Edge: role templates that include conditional scopes (time-limited, tenant-bound) will need special handling in the dryrun flow; mark them as "conditional" in output.
Priya Nair: Action list: Priya -> UX mocks + badge copy. Sam -> batch job spec + cache TTL. Evan -> API proto + sample_versioning. Taylor -> privacy opt-in modal copy + admin toggle. infra-bot: alert when indexer completes first run.
Priya Nair: Nice work, team. This gives a clearer permissions story for admins worried about accidental exposure.
Taylor G.: sg, will sync with product for rollout messaging. :thumbsup:
